quote.citation: 2021 March 31, Phil McNulty, “England 2-1 Poland: What shape are Gareth Southgate's side in?”, in BBC Sport‎[1]:
quote.text: Southgate is presiding over a talented, youthful squad and there is enough attacking weaponry to test the best in the Euros
